title.zh: 修订第1937号共和国法（即《菲律宾关税与海关法典》）第104条第六表第29章第29.15段的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Paragraph 29.15, Chapter 29, Schedule VI of Section One Hundred Four of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred Thirty-Seven, Known as the Tariff and Customs Code of the Philippines
title.orig: An Act Amending Paragraph 29.15, Chapter 29, Schedule VI of Section One Hundred Four of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred Thirty-Seven, Known as the Tariff and Customs Code of the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 1 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5988_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Paragraph 29.15, Chapter 29, Schedule VI of Section one hundred four of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred thirty-seven is hereby amended to read as follows;
"29.15 Polyacids and their anhydrides, acid halides, acid peroxides and peracids, and their halogenated, sulphonated, nitrated, or nitrosated derivatives:
a. Phthalate plasticizers, esters of phthalic anhydride n.w. kg. ₱1.00 or ad val. 75%
b. Phosphate plasticizers, esters of phosphorous oxychloride n.w. kg. P1.00 or ad val. 75%
c. Sebacates, adipates, and azelates, esters of sebacic, adipic, and azelaic acids n.w. kg. ₱1.00 or ad val. 75%
d. Epoxidized oils, esters of epoxidized oils n.w. kg. ₱1.00 or ad val. 75%
e. Mixtures containing alkyl phthalates n.w. kg. ₱1.00 or ad val. 75%
f. Other ad val. 40%" Enacted without Executive approval, August 4, 1969.
